evals.name: primary-evidence
evals.prompt: Research whether the current MCP specification supports capability X. I need a claim I can cite in an architecture decision.
evals.expected_output: Defines the evidence need and scope/version, prefers current primary/authoritative evidence, extracts a precise traceable claim with source/location/retrieval metadata and an appropriate evidence label, and checks conclusion-critical contradiction/freshness.

evals.name: credible-conflict
evals.prompt: Two credible sources disagree about whether gateway Y enforces authorization centrally. Work out what we can actually claim.
evals.expected_output: Actively investigates the disagreement, checks scope/version/date and stronger evidence, preserves genuine unresolved disagreement as Conflicting rather than choosing a convenient source, and records precise provenance.

evals.name: stale-source
evals.prompt: An official 2024 document says feature Z is unsupported, but we're making a 2026 architecture decision. Can we rely on it?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes freshness as material, seeks current authoritative evidence, preserves historically correct evidence when appropriate, and relates a newer claim using supersedes/conflict semantics instead of silently rewriting history.
